items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: She was a feature performer with Lunceford

ctx.x: Me? Let me give you an idea about Babe. Now you've got to get her expression. Babe was never a Band singer.

Babe was a personality on her own. She was a feature performer with Lunceford, the Harlem Express, a feature performer. ... Hop, I guess it might have been a year and one-half but he was a tremendous person, tremendous musician. Lot of comedy.
